content.title: Chapter 54 - MOTOR VEHICLES AND TRAFFIC — Sec. 54-32. - Deletions.
content.summary:
The following parts, sections, subsections, or appendices of the Model Traffic Code
               are inapplicable to this city and are therefore expressly deleted:

Part 1, TRAFFIC REGULATION - GENERALLY, Sections 101, 102, 104, 110.5, 111, 113, and
